scenes.say: "To whom it may concern, I'm staying!" That's how Valtteri Bottas confirmed another year at Cadillac.
A nod to his radio call after winning in Australia in twenty nineteen. That one had a much ruder ending.
His deal had an option for a second season, and the team has taken it.
Same team-mate too: Sergio Perez extended in October, through twenty twenty-nine.
The team-mate fight hasn't gone his way: Perez finished ahead fourteen times, Bottas four.
Nine retirements this year, only Stroll has more. Brakes kept failing the new team.
Cadillac is still on zero points. Best finish: Bottas, thirteenth in China.
Colton Herta earned superlicence points in practice, but there's no race seat for him yet.
Follow Bottas and Perez on the LapRadar live map.

title: Bottas stays at Cadillac for 2027: option taken, same team-mate
